title: Run credentials
description: The run starters a gateway accepts run credentials from: the list under gateway.run_credentials of the operator's forager.yaml. A run credential is a JWT (RFC 7519) signed as a JWS (RFC 7515) with an asymmetric key, which the run's starter, the iss of its run credentials, gives a run. The gateway verifies it under the keys pinned here, checks its claims, and makes the run's labels and about.details from its signed claims alone. Every failure is one opaque answer. Rules this schema cannot state, Forager checks: that every key's alg is among the starter's algorithms, that every key has a kid when there is more than one, that the kids are unique and no two starters have the same issuer, that each public_key_file holds a public key of its algorithm and none of the contract's published fixture keys, that the leeway is at most 5m, and the byte limits of a label value and of a details key.

algorithm.description: A JWS algorithm of an asymmetric key (RFC 7518, RFC 8037): RS256, RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 with SHA-256 under an RSA key of at least 2048 bits; ES256, ECDSA with SHA-256 under a P-256 key; EdDSA under an Ed25519 key. none and every HMAC algorithm are never accepted: the gateway holds public keys alone.

claim.description: The name of a claim of the run credential.

label_value.description: A label value, at most 256 bytes of UTF-8.

from_claim.description: The value of one claim, a string.

issuer.description: One run starter: who it is, the audience it mints run credentials for, its pinned keys, the claim checks and the mapping of its claims to the run's labels and about.details.
Who the starter is: an https URL with no query and no fragment, which the iss claim equals, compared as a string.

audience.description: The audience the starter mints run credentials for the gateway alone: the aud claim, a string or an array of strings, contains it. Required: a run credential minted for another service never opens a run here.

algorithms.description: The algorithms the starter signs with. A run credential's alg is one of them and equals the alg of the key it selects.

keys.description: The starter's public keys, pinned. A run credential that carries a kid selects the key of that kid; one without a kid is accepted only when exactly one key is pinned. A list of keys lets the starter rotate them.

kid.description: The key id the starter publishes the key under, which a run credential's kid header names. Required of every key when there is more than one, and unique.

public_key_file.description: The file of the public key: one PEM block of type PUBLIC KEY, a PKIX SubjectPublicKeyInfo, of the key type alg names. A private key or a certificate is refused.

leeway.description: The clock skew allowed in the checks of exp, iat and nbf. Default 60s, and at most 5m: Forager refuses a longer one, which would keep an expired run credential alive.

max_lifetime.description: The longest lifetime, exp minus iat, of a run credential the gateway accepts. When it is set, a run credential without iat is refused. Unset, the lifetime is not bounded beyond exp.

allow.description: The scope: the claim named must be a string, one of the values listed.

labels.description: The run's labels, made from the run credential's signed claims alone: nothing else the client sends sets a label.

forge.description: The label forge: a constant, or a claim.

repository.description: The label repository: the claims that name the run's target, joined in order with join, or one claim, or a constant. A claim value that contains join is refused, so two different targets never make one repository.

run_key.description: The label run_key: always the claim sub, the run key.

details.description: The keys of about.details the run credential decides, each from one claim, a string. They go into about.details, never into labels. A key follows the grammar of an about.details key and holds no =: a refusal names a key as about.details.<key>=<value>, and a key with = would make that name ambiguous.

introspection.description: The starter's OAuth 2.0 token introspection endpoint (RFC 7662), optional. The gateway posts the run credential to it, over TLS and authenticated with HTTP Basic as the client, before it opens a run, and again at most every cache while the run has connections. {"active": true} lets the run go on, {"active": false} ends it, and any other answer, or a failure to ask, counts as not active.

client_id.description: The client id the gateway authenticates to the endpoint as.

client_secret_file.description: The file of the client's secret. The secret itself never appears in this document.

cache.description: How long an answer holds before the gateway asks again. Default: the run's heartbeat interval.
